data.content_ref: inline:Introduce a warrant-provenance monad into the fixpoint iteration: each accepted or rejected status carries a proof term in a DAG of warrants. The proof terms are generated compositionally and are polynomial-size. This turns the grounded extension into a proof-carrying artifact, enabling auditing of committed roots without altering the accepted set. The expansion preserves all guarantees because the status projection is unchanged. Criticizable: proof-term explosion in practice; the proof system must be shown sound and complete for the fixed point; 'validity of every committed root' becomes a proof-checking problem rather than a semantic guarantee.
